name: Dark Vessels
summary: In Revantusk Village, Primal Torntusk says the Vilebranch fight with a fury beyond the natural. He blames Vile Priestess Hexx's foul magic and asks you to take the tainted blood vessels from Jintha'alor, so he can cleanse them.

sections.title: The Vilebranch Fury
sections.body: Across Jintha'alor, tainted blood vessels bear the power of the faceless blood God. That power strengthens the Vilebranch and drives them mad. Torntusk believes taking the vessels away and cleansing them will loosen the blood God's grip on the trolls.

sections.title: After the Vessels Return
sections.body: Returning the vessels lifts the dark energy compelling the Vilebranch, though only for now. Torntusk warns you to watch for evil, for a fallen priestess is soon replaced by another.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Dark Vessels?
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk asks you in Revantusk Village, in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Where are the tainted vessels located?
faq.answer: The tainted blood vessels lie throughout Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why are the Vilebranch trolls so ferocious?
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk blames the foul magic of Vile Priestess Hexx. The tainted blood vessels also carry the faceless blood God's power, which strengthens the Vilebranch and drives them mad.

faq.q: What does Primal Torntusk plan to do with the vessels?
aliases: what happens to the blood vessels
faq.answer: Torntusk plans to cleanse the vessels and loosen the faceless blood God's grip on the Vilebranch.
